meta.name: Lithic Choir Routing Package
meta.description: The blind monastic archivists of Quill Hollow discovered that bedrock is frozen acoustic music, using zero-damage stalls and bell harmonics to shatter equal-depth contours. Assayer Rivet has adapted this ancient resonance, creating an upgrade that directly routes 40% of newly mined Lark Newt Rivet ore directly to a paired chest, honoring the infinite scriptorium of the Lithic Choir.
